resources.string: Keeps useful Shorts, blocks the rest

ShortsSense reads the title and channel of the Short currently on screen, decides whether it is useful to you, and covers the ones that are not. Everything happens on this phone: the app has no internet permission.

When you tap "Always allow", remember that channel

ShortsSense never connects to the internet and stores nothing outside this phone. It sees what is on screen only while YouTube is in the foreground, uses the title and channel to make a decision, and keeps decisions in memory. Memes, hype edits, racy and adult content are always blocked. Limits: it can only judge by title and channel, so a clickbait title on a study channel can slip through, and a good Short with a vague title can be blocked — tap "Keep watching anyway" when that happens. Detection depends on YouTube\'s internal view IDs, which can change when YouTube updates.
Leaving Shorts did not work last time, so this screen will wait for you — tap \'Take me out\' when you are ready.
